Thinking something through.name: ask-matt
Thinking something through.line: Suggests which skill fits what you're doing, and what comes next.

Thinking something through.name: grill-me
Thinking something through.line: Interviews you closely, one question at a time, to sharpen a plan.

Thinking something through.name: grilling
Thinking something through.line: Asks hard questions about a plan, decision or idea to test it.

Thinking something through.name: grill-with-docs
Thinking something through.line: The same interview, writing down decisions and agreed words as it goes.

Thinking something through.name: domain-modeling
Thinking something through.line: Pins down the words your work uses, and records the decisions made.

Thinking something through.name: wait-what
Thinking something through.line: Explains the agent's last message again, in a different way.

Thinking something through.name: teach
Thinking something through.line: Teaches you a new skill or idea, step by step, where you are.

Planning work.name: wayfinder
Planning work.line: Maps out work too big for one conversation, then settles each decision.

Planning work.name: to-spec
Planning work.line: Turns what you've discussed into a written plan for the work.

Planning work.name: to-tickets
Planning work.line: Breaks a plan into separate tasks, saying which must come first.

Planning work.name: to-questionnaire
Planning work.line: Turns a decision you can't settle into a questionnaire for someone else.

Planning work.name: handoff
Planning work.line: Sums up the conversation in a note another agent can pick up.

Finding out and making things.name: research
Finding out and making things.line: Looks into a question using trustworthy, original sources, and saves the findings.

Finding out and making things.name: prototype
Finding out and making things.line: Builds a rough, throwaway version of something to answer a question.

Finding out and making things.name: wizard
Finding out and making things.line: Makes a step-by-step guide through things only you can do.

Finding out and making things.name: frontend-design
Finding out and making things.line: Designs pages and screens that look deliberate, not generic.

Finding out and making things.name: unslop
Finding out and making things.line: Takes the tell-tale signs of AI out of a piece of writing.

Setting up.name: jumpstart
Setting up.line: Sets up your agent: learns about you, checks with you, makes workspaces.

Setting up.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
Setting up.line: Prepares a workspace for skills (the agent runs this one when a skill needs it).
